    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Cristo Redentor | Rio de Janeiro Heritage</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>

    <style>
        :root {
            color-scheme: light;
            --bg: oklch(98% 0.01 240);
            --panel: rgba(255, 255, 255, .52);
            --panel-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, .68);
            --line: rgba(20, 30, 40, .08);
            --sky: oklch(82% 0.06 230);
            --stone: oklch(72% 0.02 240);
            --forest: oklch(66% 0.11 145);
            --amber: oklch(78% 0.12 78);
            --cyan: oklch(80% 0.13 205);
        }

        * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            margin: 0;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            background:
                radial-gradient(circle at 20% 10%, rgba(97, 218, 251, .16), transparent 18%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 82% 16%, rgba(255, 198, 109, .12), transparent 18%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 50% 100%, rgba(87, 150, 110, .08), transparent 22%),
                linear-gradient(180deg, oklch(98% 0.01 240) 0%, oklch(97% 0.01 240) 46%, oklch(95% 0.01 240) 100%);
            color: #0b1220;
            font-family: 'Inter Tight', sans-serif;
        }

        body::before {
            content: '';
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(15, 23, 42, .03) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(15, 23, 42, .03) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 96px 96px;
            mask-image: radial-gradient(circle at center, black 30%, transparent 85%);
            opacity: .5;
            z-index: -2;
        }

        .copy {
            font-family: 'PP Neue Montreal', 'Inter Tight', sans-serif;
        }

        .data {
            font-family: 'Inter Tight', sans-serif;
        }

        .serif {
            font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
            letter-spacing: -0.06em;
        }

        .sheet {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .68), rgba(255, 255, 255, .42));
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .45);
            backdrop-filter: blur(38px) saturate(1.18);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(38px) saturate(1.18);
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .6),
                0 25px 70px rgba(80, 100, 120, .1);
        }

        .sheet-mist {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .62), rgba(255, 255, 255, .34));
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .44);
            backdrop-filter: blur(50px) saturate(1.2);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(50px) saturate(1.2);
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .5),
                0 28px 100px rgba(87, 118, 145, .1);
        }

        .dew {
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            border-radius: 999px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .76), rgba(255, 255, 255, .5));
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .68);
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .72),
                0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, .28),
                0 18px 40px rgba(97, 218, 251, .08);
            transition: transform .55s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1), box-shadow .55s ease, border-color .35s ease;
        }

        .dew::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: -120%;
            background: linear-gradient(120deg, transparent 44%, rgba(255, 255, 255, .75) 50%, transparent 57%);
            transform: translateX(-140%) rotate(14deg);
            animation: sheen 8s ease-in-out infinite;
            pointer-events: none;
            mix-blend-mode: screen;
        }

        .dew:hover {
            transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.01);
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .8),
                0 0 0 1px rgba(97, 218, 251, .18),
                0 22px 50px rgba(97, 218, 251, .12);
        }

        .squircle {
            border-radius: 2rem;
        }

        .wind {
            display: inline-block;
            animation: wind 9s ease-in-out infinite;
            transform-origin: center bottom;
        }

        .bloom {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(30px) scale(.98);
            animation: bloom .9s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) forwards;
            animation-timeline: view();
            animation-range: entry 8% cover 30%;
        }

        .river-line {
            position: absolute;
            inset: auto 0;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(97, 218, 251, .4), rgba(255, 198, 109, .42), transparent);
            filter: blur(.2px);
        }

        .orbital {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            background:
                radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%, rgba(97, 218, 251, .22), transparent 20%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 55% 35%, rgba(255, 198, 109, .18), transparent 16%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(255, 255, 255, .05), transparent 42%);
            filter: blur(18px);
        }

        .portal-shell {
            will-change: transform;
            border-radius: 43% 57% 58% 42% / 40% 33% 67% 60%;
            -webkit-mask-image:
                radial-gradient(circle at 50% 46%, black 0 24%, rgba(0, 0, 0, .98) 31%, rgba(0, 0, 0, .72) 46%, transparent 70%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 18% 16%, rgba(0, 0, 0, .9) 0 10%, transparent 24%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 82% 18%, rgba(0, 0, 0, .9) 0 10%, transparent 26%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 52% 85%, rgba(0, 0, 0, .86) 0 12%, transparent 28%);
            mask-image:
                radial-gradient(circle at 50% 46%, black 0 24%, rgba(0, 0, 0, .98) 31%, rgba(0, 0, 0, .72) 46%, transparent 70%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 18% 16%, rgba(0, 0, 0, .9) 0 10%, transparent 24%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 82% 18%, rgba(0, 0, 0, .9) 0 10%, transparent 26%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 52% 85%, rgba(0, 0, 0, .86) 0 12%, transparent 28%);
            filter: drop-shadow(0 0 90px rgba(97, 218, 251, .15));
        }

        .portal-video {
            transform-origin: center center;
            will-change: transform, filter;
        }

        .soft-screen {
            backdrop-filter: blur(50px) saturate(1.2);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(50px) saturate(1.2);
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .4), rgba(255, 255, 255, .18));
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .35);
            box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .5), 0 16px 50px rgba(76, 108, 132, .08);
        }

        .mask-fade {
            -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(circle at center, black 38%, transparent 82%);
            mask-image: radial-gradient(circle at center, black 38%, transparent 82%);
        }

        .state-pulse {
            animation: pulse 4s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .title-shadow {
            text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 255, 255, .35);
        }

        @keyframes bloom {
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
            }
        }

        @keyframes sheen {
            to {
                transform: translateX(240%) rotate(14deg);
            }
        }

        @keyframes wind {

            0%,
            100% {
                transform: rotate(-1deg) translateX(-1px);
            }

            50% {
                transform: rotate(1deg) translateX(1px);
            }
        }

        @keyframes pulse {

            0%,
            100% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: .9;
            }

            50% {
                transform: scale(1.04);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        @keyframes heroScale {
            from {
                transform: scale(1.02);
            }

            to {
                transform: scale(1.14);
            }
        }

        .hero-scale {
            animation: heroScale linear both;
            animation-timeline: scroll(root);
            transform-origin: center center;
        }

        ::view-transition-old(root),
        ::view-transition-new(root) {
            animation-duration: .7s;
            animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1);
        }

        @container main (min-width: 760px) {
            .hero-copy {
                max-width: 40rem;
            }
        }
    </style>
